chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim ibn 'Urwah, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the time of zuhr and 'asr. He said: When the sun declines, then the time of zuhr and 'asr has entered together, except that this one is before this one. Then you remain within the time of both of them together until the sun sets.

key_terms.الشَّمْسُ: the sun, whose decline marks the entry of prayer time
key_terms.تَغِيبَ: sets or disappears below the horizon
key_terms.جَمِيعًا: together, indicating shared entry of the two prayer times
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time of an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When does the time of zuhr and 'asr begin according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the beginning of the time for zuhr and 'asr salat (prayer). It states that both times enter at the sun’s decline, while maintaining the order that zuhr precedes 'asr, and that their shared time continues until sunset.
